leave_personal_days_004.evidence: All employees shall receive two paid local leave days per school year in accordance with administrative regulations.

leave_personal_restrictions_005.answer: Cannot be used on state-mandated assessment days; subject to supervisor approval considering impact on educational program/operations and substitute availability; supervisors may restrict on other days; must be requested in writing in advance.
leave_personal_restrictions_005.evidence: No employee shall be granted discretionary use of state personal leave on days scheduled for state-mandated assessments. Individual supervisors may also restrict the use of state personal leave for discretionary purposes on other days. These restrictions shall be communicated by individual supervisors to their employees.

leave_personal_conversion_006.evidence: The employee shall be reimbursed for each day of unused state and local leave, to a maximum of 20 days, at the employee’s daily rate of pay immediately preceding retirement.
